title: Who's legally to blame for Anthropic and OpenAI's autonomous AI hacks? It's complicated | TechCrunch
summary: The surprise admissions by OpenAI and Anthropic that their unreleased AI models autonomously hacked into several companies have upended our understanding of America’s computer hacking laws, prompting discussions over whether the companies could face legal reprisals.
